scope: Host-only prospective decision rule; no model outcomes observed.

priority.when: Any infrastructure, isolation or grading validity failure
priority.action: Stop remaining slots; retain launched outcomes; ENVIRONMENT_INDETERMINATE; no effect-based decision.

priority.when: After first complete valid block, all three binary outcomes equal
priority.action: Stop remaining six slots as NOT_RUN; EARLY_UNIFORM_SUCCESS or EARLY_UNIFORM_FAILURE; redesign or separately calibrate in a new reviewed study; never pool.

priority.when: After all nine valid slots, all nine succeed or all nine fail
priority.action: CEILING_OR_FLOOR; unsuitable task for discrimination; redesign without pooling. This defensive branch is unreachable under the early uniform-block rule.

priority.when: All nine valid slots complete and successes_P - successes_T >= 2
priority.action: FOLLOWUP_CANDIDATE only; propose a larger preregistered multi-task study, not demonstrated general advantage.

priority.when: All nine valid slots complete and successes_P < successes_T
priority.action: NEGATIVE_PILOT_SIGNAL; do not advance on a claimed packet advantage; inspect costs and failures descriptively.

priority.when: All nine valid slots complete and successes_P - successes_T is 0 or 1
priority.action: INDETERMINATE; no positive advancement decision from this pilot.

early_stop_limit: Three equal results do not establish a population ceiling or floor; the conservation rule can miss a real effect. No arm-wise out-of-three rates or full-pilot threshold after early stop.
baseline_interpretation: Always report N. If P exceeds T but does not exceed N, interpret as possible recovery from misleading advice, not improvement over unaided repair.
